title: Filesystem semantics, symlink safety, atomicity, and permissions

tasks.title: Separate logical and physical comparers
tasks.description: Use ordinal semantics for logical keys. Introduce a root/volume-aware physical-path policy that does not assume all macOS volumes or all Unix hosts share one case model.

tasks.title: Make enumeration deterministic
tasks.description: Audit every Directory.Enumerate*/GetFiles result that influences persistence, hashing, planning, receipts, migrations, tool selection, or tests. Sort by normalized logical key with explicit tie-breaking.

tasks.title: Unify link containment policy
tasks.description: Define managed-root rules for symlinks, reparse points, junctions, missing leaves, and existing ancestors. Apply the same security contract to read, write, open, migrate, and process-target validation.

tasks.title: Harden file operations against races
tasks.description: Minimize check/use gaps, revalidate parent identity immediately before mutation, keep temporary files in the target directory, and document any residual TOCTOU risk that cannot be eliminated with managed APIs.

tasks.title: Create atomic persistence primitives
tasks.description: Implement tested temporary-write, flush, replace, backup, cleanup, and cancellation semantics for small JSON/key/catalog files and large storage payloads where appropriate.

tasks.title: Add bounded cross-process coordination
tasks.description: Protect control-plane, key/vault, and catalog generation changes with a process-safe lock or transactional authority. Prove contention, stale/recovery, timeout, and cancellation behavior.

tasks.title: Apply Unix ownership and modes
tasks.description: Create private directories and files with the required modes, verify actual modes after move/migration, and refuse to use secret-bearing paths when hardening fails.

tasks.title: Define portable physical filenames
tasks.description: Replace host invalid-character behavior with an application policy, collision handling, reserved-name handling, length limits, Unicode normalization decision, and preserved display names.

tasks.title: Make watchers convergent
tasks.description: Treat events as hints, deduplicate/debounce by generation, schedule deterministic rescan/fingerprint after overflow/error, and provide a polling fallback for unsupported/unreliable roots.

tasks.title: Run malicious and failure-injection fixtures
tasks.description: Test link swaps, case collisions, concurrent writers, process crash, full disk/permission failure where feasible, watcher overflow, rename storms, and cleanup boundaries.
